_about: Operating systems and firmware. Fields: id (stable), display, vendor and product (the inventory and exploited-list name; key lower(vendor)|lower(product)), also (other vendor|product names of it), cpe (NVD part:vendor:product, a trailing * matches a prefix), kev (other exploited-list keys), scheme, trains, class, linux/linux_prefix/linux_upstream (package names; upstream = the vendor's own package), windows/windows_prefix (lower-case program names), nmap (the CPE nmap prints), patterns (program or package names, (?i)^…, with the distribution and the release the name states: version "$1", or "-" when the reported version is not the release). Read by core/productid; checked by its tests.
